backing.collateral_ratio_basis: USDS balanceOf(sUSDS) / sUSDS totalAssets(). Two independent reads: the numerator is a token balance, the denominator is derived from the chi accumulator. 100% means the vault holds what its shares can claim.

integrity.note: Signed (held - totalAssets) / totalAssets. A small NEGATIVE value is the expected state: interest accrues via chi continuously but is drawn from the vow periodically, so reported assets run slightly ahead of the balance.

upstream.name: USDS
upstream.note: 100% of sUSDS backing. sUSDS carries USDS's collateral risk in full -- see the USDS page for what stands behind it.

dependencies.downstream_note: sUSDS is widely used as lending collateral (Spark, Morpho, Aave). Those positions are not enumerated here.

liquidity.two_pct_depth_unresponsive_note: ⚠️ NOT SIZE-RESPONSIVE: every rung from $1,000 to $1,000,000 returned the identical 0.00bps. The quote path is not responding to size, so this bounds nothing -- the same call would clear any number. Real capacity is set by the venue's fixed-rate pocket, which this ladder does not measure.
liquidity.two_pct_depth_basis: ⚠️ NOT SIZE-RESPONSIVE: every rung from $1,000 to $1,000,000 returned the identical 0.00bps. liquidity.note: Primary exit is redemption: ERC-4626 redeem() into USDS, no cooldown or queue. The ladder below is the secondary DEX exit. ⚠️ EXTENDING THIS LADDER WOULD NOT RAISE THE FLOOR: probing above the $1M top rung returns a CONSTANT 1078.15bps at $5M, $10M, $25M, $50M and $100M alike — identical to the hundredth of a basis point across a 20x range, which is a redemption rate being returned as a quote, not a fill. So the floor is where the venue stops answering, not where depth runs out, and the extra rungs would import a constant rather than locate a crossing. (USDS itself trips the size-responsiveness check outright — exactly 0.00bps to $50M — because it routes the Sky PSM, a fixed-rate swap bounded by pocket balance and not by slippage.) ⚠️ NOT SIZE-RESPONSIVE: every rung from $1,000 to $1,000,000 returned the identical 0.00bps. pause_surface.note: sUSDS exposes no pause state, so summary.paused is null because there is nothing to read -- not because a read failed. The equivalent risk on this asset is an implementation upgrade.

backing.basis: sUSDS sits AT par by construction: the ratio is a token balance over a chi-derived value, two independent reads, so a residual of ~1e-5pp is arithmetic noise rather than a shortfall. The generic [130,110,100,90] puts a band edge exactly at 100 and rates that noise 2/5. Same shape as sibling usds.
backing.expires_reason: Anchored on par, which does not drift.
